changes.description: Updates gameImpls[621] from 0xeF9eCeA15265321753047EBF7D54C858D53cB94f (version 0.2.0) to 0xc08b8fFAF04Abb1d7013B74a0E57Eccbd7fa5A70 (version 0.3.0), which switches the proposal intervals from 600/30 to 6000/300 blocks at Denim. Existing games are unchanged.

Updates the ResourceMetering parameters (prevBlockNum, prevBoughtGas, prevBaseFee) after the thirteen L2 ProxyAdmin upgrade deposits. The values depend on the L1 block at simulation time, so a signer's own run can differ.
Sets the _timestamps array length from 13 to 14, registering Denim as upgrade id 13.
Sets the _upgradeScheduleId array length from 14 to 15: one more hash-chain link for the new upgrade.
Raises minimumProtocolVersion from v1.4.2 to v1.5.1 (0x00000001_00000005_00000001_00000000).
_upgradeScheduleId[14]: hash-chain link committing to upgrade id 13 (denim) at 1793901600. As the tail of the chain, this is the registry's new scheduleId.
_timestamps[12..15] packed: the previous last entry stays at 1790791200 and denim (id 13) is scheduled for 1793901600, which is 2026-11-05 18:00:00 UTC.
